page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sccc7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 128 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core, aligning the hardware profile with compute-intensive workloads.

The instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network storage volumes. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. There are no bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated Intel Xeon cores provides significant parallel processing capacity, though the low memory-per-core ratio represents a tradeoff for memory-bound applications. The lack of local storage requires architectural reliance on network-attached storage, which may impact I/O latency. This instance is designed for highly parallelized, compute-heavy workloads such as batch processing, scientific modeling, high-performance computing, and large-scale compilation tasks.
